page.layout: One blank page of a bound book, with a handwritten pencil shelf number at the upper left and faint pencil marks at the upper right. The digitiser's credit line at the foot is not transcribed.
page.notes: Blank leaf, no printed text. The pencil number "92209" at the upper left is a library shelf mark (handwriting) and is left out. Faint pencil scribbles at the upper right are handwriting and are left out. The black band at the foot carries the digitiser's credit (Early European Books, ProQuest; Wellcome Trust, 3439/A) and is left out. The left edge shows the neighbouring page and the book's edge; the right edge shows the binding.
